desc: Analyze the problem and derive the visibility condition: Building $i$ is visible from $(0, h)$ iff $\min_{j < i} R_j^{(i)}(h) \ge 0$, where $R_j^{(i)}(h) = \frac{X_i}{X_j}H_j - h(\frac{X_i}{X_j} - 1)$.
Determine that "All buildings visible" is a monotonic property: if visible at $h$, visible at $h' > h$. We want the maximum $h$ where it is NOT visible.
Identify that the threshold is where $\min_{i, j<i} R_j^{(i)}(h) = 0$.
Implement the binary search for $h$ in range $[0, 2 \cdot 10^9]$.
Implement the $O(N)$ check function using prefix minimums of $V_j(h) = (H_j - h)/X_j$.
Verify logic against sample cases and edge cases (e.g., output -1).
